title: A Psychometric and Practical Comparison of Standard Moodle-Based and STACK-Based Step-by-Step Tests in University Calculus
summary: This paper compares two formats of online assessment in university Calculus: a standard Moodle-based step-by-step test and a STACK-based step-by-step test. Both tests assess integration by parts and divide the solution into consecutive response fields, but they differ in their validation mechanisms. The standard test relies on predefined scoring patterns, whereas the STACK-based test uses symbolic validation rules.
